question: As of 31st October 2020, The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has ________ members countries.
solution:
The correct answer is __**190**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• As of 31st October 2020, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) has **190 member countries**.
 
• The IMF was established on** December 27, 1945**, in **Washington, D.C**.
 
• The primary purpose of the IMF is to **ensure the stability of the international monetary system**.
 
• The IMF provides financial assistance and advice to member countries facing economic difficulties.
 
• It also works to promote global economic growth and stability by providing policy advice, financial assistance, and technical assistance to its member countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **History of IMF Membership:**

 
 
• The IMF started with 29 member countries when it was founded in 1944.
 
• Membership has expanded over the years to include 190 countries as of October 2020.
 
• Countries must apply for membership and meet certain requirements to join the IMF.
 
 
 
• **Functions of the IMF:**
 
 
• **Surveillance**: Monitoring economic and financial developments and providing policy advice.
 
• **Financial Assistance**: Providing loans to member countries facing balance of payments problems.
 
• **Technical Assistance**: Offering training and support to help countries improve their economic management.
 
 
 
• **IMF's Role in Global Economy:**
 
 
• The IMF plays a crucial role in **stabilizing the global economy **by providing **financial support and policy advice **to countries in need.
 
• It helps to prevent and resolve economic crises by promoting sound economic policies and practices.
 
• The IMF also works to **reduce poverty and support sustainable economic growth **through its various programs and initiatives.
